notes: A replay harness reads from the recording instead of the network, which is what makes
a fix testable in milliseconds against a run that already happened.
Two divergence checks, because neither can see the other's failure. Once and exactly:
the serving slice — model and effort — because a model upgrade alters no prompt text
and makes every recorded response stale at once. Then per step and tolerantly: did the
Prompt drift is the Jaccard distance over whitespace-separated tokens, in basis points
with floor(x + 0.5). Two empty prompts drift by nothing.
A recording that runs out is exhausted rather than diverged: the code asked for a call
the run never made, which is a different fact about a different bug.
